    def on_snapshot(self, sym, bids, asks, now):
        if sym not in self.s or len(bids) < 5 or not asks:
            return
        self.c.cur = sym
        c, s = self.c, self.s[sym]
        s["snap"] = {p: q for p, q in bids}
        s["bids_snap"], s["asks_snap"], s["snap_t"] = bids, asks, now
        bid0 = bids[0][0]
        notion = [p * q for p, q in bids]
        loc = self._local_med(notion)
        near = [nv for (p, q), nv in zip(bids, notion) if (bid0 - p) / bid0 * 1e4 <= 100]
        floor = max(c["WALL_MIN_USDT"], c["WALL_FLOOR_X"] * statistics.median(near))
        s["floor"] = floor
        cands = {}
        for i, ((p, q), nv) in enumerate(zip(bids, notion)):
            dist = (bid0 - p) / bid0 * 1e4
            if c["MIN_DIST_BPS"] <= dist <= c["MAX_DIST_BPS"] and nv >= max(floor, c["WALL_MULT"] * loc[i]):
                cands[p] = (nv, dist)
        self._zones_track(s, bids, asks, cands, now)
        born = {r["near"]: r["t_first"] for r in s["zact"] if r["kind"] == "wall"}     # возраст считаем по живой записи стенки
        s["seen"] = {p: born.get(p, now) for p in cands}
        ripe = sorted((d, p, nv) for p, (nv, d) in cands.items() if now - s["seen"][p] >= c["WALL_AGE"])
        s["wall"] = dict(price=ripe[0][1], usdt=ripe[0][2], dist=ripe[0][0]) if ripe else None
        self._study_new(s, bids, notion, statistics.median(notion), cands, ripe, now)
        self._clus_new(s, bids, now)
        self._brk_scan(s, asks, now)

        o, pos = s["order"], s["pos"]
        if pos and "wall" in pos and c["EXIT_ON_WALL_GONE"] and not s["mkt"]:
            if s["snap"].get(pos["wall"], 0.0) * pos["wall"] < 0.3 * pos["usdt"]:
                s["order"] = None
                s["mkt"] = dict(t=now + c["LATENCY"], why="wall_gone")
                self.log(now, sym, "wall_gone", pos["wall"], "")
            return
        if o and not pos and o["side"] == "buy" and "wall" in o:
            if s["snap"].get(o["wall"], 0.0) * o["wall"] < 0.5 * o["wall_usdt"]:
                s["order"] = None
                self.log(now, sym, "buy_cancel", o["price"], "стенку сняли")
            return
        if pos or o or s["mkt"] or now < s["cool"] or not s["wall"] or now - s["t_book"] > 2:
            return
        if sym not in c["TRADE_PAIRS"] or c["ENTRY_MODE"] == "breakout":
            return
        w = s["wall"]
        gaps = [round(bids[i][0] - bids[i + 1][0], 10) for i in range(len(bids) - 1)]
        tick = min(g for g in gaps if g > 0)
        price = round(w["price"] + tick, 10)
        zone = None
        if len(bids) >= 50:
            for cl in self.clus_list(bids, "bid"):
                if cl["far"] - tick <= w["price"] <= cl["near"] + tick:
                    zone = cl
                    break
        if c["STOP_FROM_ENTRY_BPS"]:
            stop = price * (1 - c["STOP_FROM_ENTRY_BPS"] / 1e4)
        else:
            ref = zone["far"] if (zone and c["STOP_REF"] == "zone") else w["price"]
            stop = ref * (1 - c["STOP_UNDER_WALL_BPS"] / 1e4)
        risk = (price - stop) / price * 1e4
        if price >= bid0 or risk > c["MAX_RISK_BPS"]:
            return
        s["order"] = dict(side="buy", price=price, qty=c["NOTIONAL"] / price, t_place=now,
                          t_act=now + c["LATENCY"], queue=None, obi=w["dist"], spread=s["spread"],
                          wall=w["price"], wall_usdt=w["usdt"], stop=stop, q0=s["snap"].get(price, 0.0),
                          ref=dict(wall=w["price"], zone_near=zone and zone["near"], zone_far=zone and zone["far"],
                                   mode=c["STOP_REF"] if zone else "wall"))
        self.log(now, sym, "buy_order", price, "стенка %.5g %.0f USDT, %.1f б.п. ниже, риск %.0f б.п." %
                 (w["price"], w["usdt"], w["dist"], risk))
